title: Wizard in Enchanted Ceiling
description: A long-haired bearded man looks upward from a candlelit room as a swirling magical vortex expands across the ceiling. A glowing golden crown floats above a lit ceiling fan amid flying papers, colorful paint splashes, dark horned shadows, and ethereal purple energy.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a long-haired bearded man in a candlelit room looking up at a swirling magical vortex on the ceiling, a glowing golden crown with jewels floats near a spinning ceiling fan with light bulbs, dark horned shadow creatures, flying papers, vibrant blue purple and gold paint splashes, mystical atmosphere, dynamic composition viewed from below
